function.name: write_html_app
function.description: Create an interactive HTML app as a new workspace file and open it on the canvas. The app runs in a sandbox without network access and reads the declared workspace tables live through the DF runtime. Revise an existing app with edit_file instead.

filename.description: New visible filename ending in .html, without directories, for example sales_explorer.html.

title.description: Short single-line title shown to the user (at most 80 characters).

tables.description: Workspace table names the app reads with DF.query or DF.table. Only these tables are available to the app.

html.description: The complete HTML document, with inline CSS and JavaScript only. Do not load external scripts, stylesheets, fonts, or images.
